name: Humanly Possible V3
inspiration: Field Glass: Sanji's motion craft (12-sanji: liquid glass, toggles, nature under frosted glass, uppit text, dither/dot/grid transitions) rebuilt in the HP brand system (Pulse Combined, Mark B). The HP burn gradient is treated as low sun from the bottom-left.
summary: Warm smoked-oxblood glass over HP-graded nature photography. Signature moves: sunrise (light burns up from the bottom-left), condense (glass fogs in like breath), heartbeat (the logo's lub-dub) for emphasis, window wipe (key number wiped clear through frost), plain rounded glass panes, burn-dither transition. Glass allowed (overrides the brand no-glass rule); no stripes, keylines, flat shadows or overshoot (lint-hp-tells.mjs v3 profile).
motion: HP pop cubic-bezier(.2,.9,.25,1) for arrivals, uppit settle cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1) for text and glass, glide for light and wind. No overshoot. Heartbeat 1.07/1.045 for emphasis.
transitions: Burn dither (light front from the burn origin through the palette ramp). Planned: seed dissolve, field flip, frost wipe, sunset cut.
textPreset: uppit-reveal (lib/text-preset.js, copied from 12-sanji): per word opacity + blur 6px + 0.3em rise, 0.7s cubic-bezier(.23,1,.32,1), 40ms stagger.

cards.notes: Sunrise on a golden field, rounded glass panel condenses from the burn corner, four toggles flip in turn (cream), the last one is the orange payoff and takes the heartbeat. One gold word in the headline.

Chapter title: sunrise + rack focus on backlit fern, rounded glass pane condenses, gold chapter number before the eyebrow, one orange word in the two-line headline, white lockup top-left, sun glint on the hold.
Full-bleed frost condenses over a sunlit meadow, the hero number is wiped clear through it (gold-warmed photo inside the glyphs), heartbeat, unit + line pour in, glint through the numeral.
Bayer-dithered light front from the burn origin; cells pass gold, orange, brick, oxblood, deep and open onto scene B; B's glass chip condenses after.

Default cream paper (Sanji paper-resolve in HP): hero word dollies in and pulls back, words pour in and re-center, the <em> word types behind an orange caret. Ink is oxblood on cream/photo (photo adds a cream lift over the high-key field) and flips to cream on oxblood/deep/brick/none. No grain, no light, no corner glow.

Default photo (field-sunset) + grain + light ON (one of group A's two light cards: the burn mosaic burning off from the sun corner is the reveal). Rounded glass pane sized to the line, optional gold <em>, sunset exit. Flat grounds: solid glass, no mosaic. none: glass caption over footage.

Corner sun pool removed.

slots.name: log
slots.note: newline-separated, 6-14 lines; seeded ledger filler follows

cards.notes: HERO (light on). Sun-reeds rendered as glyphs on deep, burn-tinted from the bottom-left: field log note + headline, quiet hold while first light comes up, morning ledger floods with [ ok ] column, letters let go as seeds and the field wakes. Light off = plain cream glyphs; none = the ledger alone on a blank screen.

HERO (light on): the low sun drawn as a shimmering glyph field on deep. KEY > VALUE chip, birds step around it, list one item per half beat, tagline, then the HP mark rises as glyphs beside the wordmark with a blinking cursor. Light off or none = Sanji-clean: statement, chip, mark, empty field.
